key_idea: The year ends in 00 in base b iff b*b divides y; try b = 2..16.
sketch: Loop over bases, test y % (b*b) == 0, and print y in that base with lowercase letters for digits above 9; otherwise print impossible. y>=1 so there is no leading-zero issue. Any valid base is accepted, so the token checker reports WRONG on samples where I print a smaller base; samples_passed is from my own validator, which checked all y in 1..2024 (value round-trips, ends in 00, impossible only when no base works).
